cohort: The study included 35,899 women aged 18-45 years undergoing medically assisted procreation treatments, who were prescribed at least one gonadotropin between 2007 and 2019 in Latium, Italy.
finding: Compared to extractives, recombinant and combined treatments showed a stronger association with conception rate, with combined protocols performing slightly better in terms of conception and birth rate, while maternal and infantile safety profiles were similar across all gonadotropin formulations.
